description: This file implements Bluetooth Direction Finding (DF) features, including antenna info, CTE (Constant Tone Extension) configuration, and IQ report handling for Bluetooth connections and advertising sets.

methods.name: le_df_init
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth Direction Finding by reading antenna info and setting internal state.

methods.name: bt_df_set_adv_cte_tx_param
methods.description: Sets CTE transmission parameters for an advertising set.

methods.name: bt_df_adv_cte_tx_enable
methods.description: Enables CTE transmission for an advertising set.

methods.name: bt_df_adv_cte_tx_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE transmission for an advertising set.

methods.name: bt_df_per_adv_sync_cte_rx_enable
methods.description: Enables CTE reception for a periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: bt_df_per_adv_sync_cte_rx_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE reception for a periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_rx_enable
methods.description: Enables CTE reception on a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_rx_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE reception on a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_set_conn_cte_tx_param
methods.description: Sets CTE transmission parameters for a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_req_enable
methods.description: Enables CTE request procedure on a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_req_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE request procedure on a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_rsp_enable
methods.description: Enables CTE response procedure on a connection.

methods.name: bt_df_conn_cte_rsp_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE response procedure on a connection.
